blocks.prompt: 11. The \(5^{\text{th}}\) term of an arithmetic progression is 21 and the sum of first six terms is 90. Find the \(18^{\text{th}}\) term.
blocks.explanation:
Ek term aur ek jama diya hai, aur poochhi 18th term gayi hai. Koi bhi term nikalne ke liye \(a_1\) aur \(d\) chahiye.
Diya kya hai? 5th term 21 aur pehli chhe terms ka jama 90.
Find kya karna hai? 18th term.
Plan: do equations banana, \(a_1\) aur \(d\) nikalna, phir \(a_{18} = a_1 + 17d\).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(a_5 = 21\), \(S_6 = 90\).
Humein find karna hai: \(a_{18}\).
Tareeqa: \(a_n = a_1 + (n - 1)d\) se ek equation aur \(S_n = \frac{n}{2}[2a_1 + (n - 1)d]\) se doosri. Yeh pichhle sawal jaisa hi kaam hai, bas aakhir mein jama ki jagah ek term nikalni hai.

5th term se equation
\[a_1 + 4d = 21 \quad (1)\]
Kyun: \(a_5 = a_1 + (5 - 1)d = a_1 + 4d\).

Jama se equation
\[90 = \dfrac{6}{2}(2a_1 + 5d)\]
\[2a_1 + 5d = 30 \quad (2)\]
Kyun: \(n = 6\) rakha to \(\frac{6}{2} = 3\) aur \((n - 1)d = 5d\). Dono taraf 3 se divide kiya: \(90 \div 3 = 30\).

Solve karein
\[2 \times (1):\ 2a_1 + 8d = 42\]
\[\text{subtract (2)}:\ 3d = 12\]
\[d = 4,\quad a_1 = 21 - 16 = 5\]
Kyun: (1) mein \(a_1\) hai aur (2) mein \(2a_1\). (1) ko 2 se multiply kiya to dono mein \(2a_1\) ho gaya; ab minus karne se \(a_1\) cancel aur \(8d - 5d = 3d\), \(42 - 30 = 12\). \(d = 4\) ko (1) mein rakha: \(a_1 = 21 - 16 = 5\).
Dhyan dein: Equation ko 2 se multiply karte waqt right side (21) ko bhi multiply karna zaroori hai: 42.

18th term nikalein
\[a_{18} = a_1 + 17d\]
\[= 5 + 17(4) = 73\]
Kyun: Pehli term se 18th term tak 17 qadam, har qadam 4. \(17 \times 4 = 68\), aur \(5 + 68 = 73\).

Tasdeeq
\[a_5 = 5 + 16 = 21 \;\checkmark\]
\[S_6 = 5 + 9 + 13 + 17 + 21 + 25\]
\[= 90 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Series 5, 9, 13, 17, 21, 25, ... hai. 5th term 21 hai aur pehli chhe ka jama 90 hai; dono baatein sahi.
